instruction: Board-Setup Manufacturing Defaults `board.kicad_pro` and `board.kicad_pcb` form a loadable KiCad 10.0.2 PCB worksheet project. For this task, start KiCad with `/usr/bin/kicad`; the board and schematic editors are also available directly at `/usr/bin/pcbnew` and `/usr/bin/eeschema`. The board already contains two routed rails, board-outline graphics, a fabrication note, and a courtyard guide. Its current board-setup defaults were copied from an overly coarse template. `/home/user/Desktop/fab_setup.json` lists the routing minima and default drawing/text settings that the fabrication team expects. Use the opened board project in KiCad PCB Editor, apply Board Setup values from `/home/user/Desktop/fab_setup.json`, and save the project without changing the worksheet board geometry or routed items. Requirements: 1. `board.kicad_pro`: `board.design_settings.rules` must match the routing minima in `/home/user/Desktop/fab_setup.json`. 2. `board.kicad_pro`: `board.design_settings.defaults` must match the silkscreen, fabrication-text, and courtyard settings in `/home/user/Desktop/fab_setup.json`. 3. `board.kicad_pcb` must remain a loadable copy of the worksheet board, preserving its outline, two routed rails, fabrication note, and courtyard guide. 4. No project changes outside `board.design_settings.rules` and `board.design_settings.defaults` are allowed. Save the finished project files as `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pro` and `/home/user/Desktop/board.kicad_pcb`.
